editions.source: Clarim Diário sex 06/11 — montado por mim (Bruna) às 10:0x Fortaleza, atrasado ~1h. Nenhum packet de repórter existia ainda (rondas começam 12:00). As 5 URLs foram lidas com xread --json agora (janela 00:50Z→12:55Z, 12h), hora UTC, autor, id e engajamento conferidos no mesmo minuto.

posts.text: The next big names could be on your radar before they hit the public markets. Explore trending pre-IPO assets with the new Bybit Pre-IPO page.
posts.pt: Bybit lançou a página de ativos pré-IPO: 'the next big names before they hit the public markets'.

options.a: pre-IPO, IPO, post-IPO. the only label that matters is whether you can sell it at 3am
options.b: pre-ipo access is the headline. whether it can still trade after the bell is the product
options.c: the rails are old wine, the venue is new. watch what happens when the first one gaps overnight

posts.text: not stopping until we tokenize the world
posts.pt: xStocksFi, linha de marca: 'not stopping until we tokenize the world'.

options.a: tokenize the world and still nobody can explain where the settlement happens. love it
options.b: tokenize all of it. we will keep the after-hours part boring and liquid
options.c: the world is the easy part. the 3am bid is the hard one

posts.text: Mantle Network remained fully operational throughout the state-root bug recently disclosed in the upstream Reth client. Yesterday, our team moved quickly and proactively shipped a fix in op-reth mantle-v1.6.3, which backports the upstream patch. User assets are safe.
posts.pt: Mantle seguiu operando durante o bug de state-root do Reth e já publicou op-reth mantle-v1.6.3 com o patch.

options.a: an upstream client bug that woke nobody up. that is the flex
options.b: chain stayed up through an upstream reth bug. boring uptime is what a venue is actually built on
options.c: the quiet part of a dex is the client patch shipped before anyone noticed. liquidity is downstream of uptime

posts.text: JUST IN: 128 Japanese credit unions hit by widespread outages, leaving customers unable to withdraw cash or conduct transactions.
posts.pt: 128 cooperativas de crédito japonesas fora do ar; clientes sem saque nem transação.

options.a: 128 credit unions down and gas still confirmed in two seconds
options.b: the banks go dark on a friday morning. tokenized equities keep settling at 3am. different rails
options.c: people never stop needing to move their money. they just lose the ability to

posts.text: JUST IN: South Korean crypto exchange Gopax halts withdrawals following hacking threat.
posts.pt: Exchange sul-coreana Gopax parou saques após ameaça de hack.

options.a: withdrawals paused is the fastest education on what custody means
options.b: custody is the whole argument. a dex has no withdrawals to pause, only a book to fill
options.c: halting withdrawals is not a hack, it is a design. nobody wants to say that part

own_post_options.A: pre-ipo is the new listing. the real question is what happens after the bell.
own_post_options.B: tokenized equities were never about the ticker. they are about the hours the market is closed.
